items: 【Applicable Streaming Devices & TVs】The upgraded voice remote control compatible with TV Stick(1st Gen-2nd Gen-3rd Gen-Lite-4K-4K Max) and TV Cube (1st Gen-2nd Gen-3rd Gen), compatible with voice smart TVs(2-series-4-series-Omni series-Omni QLED series-3rd Gen)and for Smart TVs

【Remote Compatibility】Our replacement remote especially for following remote model: compatible with Voice Remote(2nd Gen-3rd Gen-Lite-Lite 2nd Gen) and TV remote control(NS-RCFNA-21, CT-95018, CT-RC1US-21, NS-RCFNA-19,CT-RC1US-19) etc.

【Voice Search & Shortcut Button】Replacement L5B83G 3rd voice remote comes with 4 shortcut buttons, including video, NFLX, Dis+ and hulu. It also comes with voice search function, enhance your viewing experience by effortlessly searching for content and accessing popular streaming services.
